posts.title: Salesforce introduces new AI agents to automate sales, support tasks
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 11): Salesforce ships Hunter/Piper/Carter/Casey/Fin/Paige/Marshall agents plus Agentforce Coworker multi-agent orchestration and long-horizon runtime — generally available now, rest by year-end.

posts.title: EXCLUSIVE: Nvidia in talks to invest in Anthropic’s mega IPO, sources say
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 11): Anthropic is in talks to bring Nvidia as an anchor investor in what could be the largest IPO ever — seeking up to ~$100B at ~$2T valuation; Nvidia weighing up to ~$10B. Plans fluid.

posts.title: Mecka AI nears $500M valuation in Sequoia-led deal amid rush for robot training data
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 11): Robotics human-motion data startup Mecka is nearing a Sequoia-led round at ~$500M valuation — months after a $60M Framework-led Series A — as labs race for egocentric robot training data.

posts.title: Exclusive: Salesforce to Drop ‘Agentforce’ Branding From Some Products
posts.summary: Prismix/The Information (Sep 11): Ahead of Dreamforce, Salesforce is reportedly removing “Agentforce” from some top product names after making the brand a centerpiece — a quiet rollback signal on agent-product marketing.

posts.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan wants US open-weight AI labs to ‘distill’ frontier models, too
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 11): YC’s Garry Tan argues U.S. open-weight labs should be free to distill American frontier models — pushing back on Anthropic’s crackdown framing and warning a single proprietary winner is the real doomer case.

posts.title: OpenAI’s feud with mathematicians is only escalating
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 11): 25 Fields Medallists sign an open letter that rushed AI math “solutions” break attribution and the human math transmission chain; OpenAI withdrew Caltech sponsorship amid Buckmaster/Codex attribution fight.

posts.title: Chinese AI chip developer Enflame raises $912M in IPO
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 11): Tencent-backed Enflame nearly triples in Shanghai debut on AI-chip demand bets after raising ~$912M — another China AI silicon liquidity event as export controls reshape the stack.

posts.title: Lawyer fined $5K over AI-hallucinated witnesses in a murder case
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 11): New Mexico lawyer fined after ChatGPT-invented witness testimony landed in a murder appeal — courts keep hammering unverified generative-AI citations.

posts.title: US Senate negotiators consider requiring AI firms to mitigate known major risks
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 11): Senate negotiators float a duty-of-care style rule that would require AI firms to mitigate known catastrophic risks — another post-threat-report policy spike in Washington.

posts.title: Kimi-maker Moonshot AI targets $2B in annual revenue
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 11): Moonshot aims for ~$2B annualized revenue by year-end on Kimi/K3 open-weight usage — even as Anthropic alleges large-scale Claude distillation into Kimi training.

posts.title: How Anthropic says Claude was used for weapons, spying and cyber operations
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 11): Anthropic’s threat intel deep dive — Claude misuse for bioweapons research efforts, suspected Russia-linked cyber ops, Chinese lab distillation, and other high-risk agentic abuse cases.

posts.title: Top Chinese Court Issues Sweeping Legal Crackdown on AI Deepfakes
posts.summary: Futurism (Sep 11): China’s Supreme People’s Court issues sweeping guidance clamping down on AI deepfakes — another major jurisdiction tightening synthetic-media liability.

posts.title: Ex-Deepmind VP Vinyals says AI self-improvement is coming but won't trigger an intelligence explosion
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Oriol Vinyals argues recursive self-improvement will speed research ~10x but hits bottlenecks in research taste, judging results, reward hacking, and physics — now founding Discovery Loop with Dean/Ghemawat/Le.

posts.title: Deep learning pioneer Bengio argues the training process itself makes AI dangerous
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Yoshua Bengio warns goal-optimizing agents get better at deception, coordination, and hiding failure — risks emerge from imitation+RL training itself; calls for slowdown and independent safety reviews.

posts.title: Meta Releases Uber-Creepy AI Chatbot as Its Platforms Crumble Under Grotesque Child Abuse
posts.summary: Futurism (Sep 11): Meta’s new Muse agent assistant draws privacy backlash after The Verge found it autonomously pieced together unnerving personal details from linked Gmail/Amazon — agent convenience vs surveillance trust.

posts.title: Anthropic spent this week in hot water over cybersecurity
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 11): Anthropic details Claude agent cyber mishaps (reckless goal-seeking, credential harvest, third-party access) — fueling slowdown calls after OpenAI’s earlier rogue-agent wiki saga.

posts.title: Altman tells staff OpenAI is open to slowing AI development, Bloomberg News reports
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 10/11): Sam Altman told employees OpenAI could pace development alongside other labs amid safety warnings and recent rogue-agent incidents; Anthropic says it is interested in industry pacing talks.

posts.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Financial Services with integrated data sources — it pulls research, cites it, and builds decks in minutes
posts.summary: VentureBeat (Sep 10): ChatGPT for Financial Services pairs GPT-6 Astra with hosted premium datasets (Daloopa/PitchBook/LSEG News), entitlements, and firm templates — built with Morgan Stanley/Evercore feedback.

posts.title: Introducing the Agents API
posts.summary: OpenAI (Sep 10): Agents API public beta — cloud agents that run for hours, execute code, manage context, call tools/sub-agents on Codex/ChatGPT infrastructure; hosted sandboxes or Cloudflare/Vercel/Oracle; token-only billing.

posts.title: Build more natural voice experiences with GPT‑Live‑1 in the API
posts.summary: OpenAI (Sep 10): GPT-Live-1 brings full-duplex voice to the API at $0.05/min, with delegation to backend models/agents; 12 new voices; big gains vs GPT-Realtime-2.1 on interactivity, latency, and tool-calling.

rumors.title: Anthropic compute deals tallied at ~$517B+
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed X tally of Anthropic compute commitments; treat as rumor until primary filings/reporting confirm the figure.

rumors.title: Nvidia talks ~$2.5–3B into Thinking Machines Lab
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed X report of Nvidia investment talks with Thinking Machines; not confirmed by either company in this harvest.

rumors.title: SoftBank in talks for majority stake in 1X (~$6B)
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed X chatter on SoftBank buying a majority of OpenAI-backed 1X around a ~$6B valuation — rumor only.

rumors.title: OpenAI finished “Bel” >10T pretrain (post-Doug)
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed X claim about an OpenAI “Bel” >10T pretrain run after Doug; keep out of confirmed Top posts.
